paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: The performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (+%) achieved by VisuoThink through predictive rollout search across three large vision-language models—GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL—under two supervision conditions: “Strong Supervision” (represented by hatched blue bars) and “Weak Supervision” (solid light blue bars). The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gain (+%)”, ranges from 0 to 30 with major tick marks at intervals of 5. For GPT-4o, strong supervision yields a performance gain of approximately 24.5%, while weak supervision results in a gain of about 5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, strong supervision produces a gain of roughly 9.5%, compared to approximately 3.5% under weak supervision. Qwen2-72B-VL shows a strong supervision gain of about 15% and a weak supervision gain of approximately 5.5%. The bars are grouped by model along the horizontal axis, with strong supervision bars consistently taller than their weak supervision counterparts, indicating greater performance improvement under stronger guidance. The legend at the top clarifies the visual encoding of supervision strength via bar fill patterns and color shades.
